name: markor_edit_note
intent: Add text to the top of a note in Markor
description: Opens the specified note file in Markor, prepends the requested text to the existing note content, navigates back to save, and reopens the note to verify the edit.
patterns: Add text to the top of a note
Update a note file in Markor

inputs.name: text_to_add
inputs.description: The text to add to the top of the note

steps.intent: Tap the file {{note_file_name}} to open the note
Type {{text_to_add}} at the top of the note, followed by the existing note content
Go back to dismiss the keyboard
Go back to return to the file list and save the note
Tap the file {{note_file_name}} to reopen the note and verify the edit

outputs.name: updated_note_content
outputs.example: Hello, World! Don't forget to water the plants while I'm away.

data_values: Don't forget to water the plants while I'm away.
